metadata.artifact_name: NEXUS-SLM ML Improvement Campaign & Model Comparison Matrix

eval_benchmark_locked_test.policy: IMMUTABLE_LOCKED — strictly preserved, never used for training or repeated hyperparameter search

payment_failure.root_cause: High semantic overlap with refund_request and billing. Truncated synthetic text fragments in training data (e.g. 'UPI payment successful dikha?').

order_tracking.root_cause: Severe semantic confusion with delivery_issue. Tickets inquiring about live status are misrouted to delivery complaints.

technical_issue.root_cause: Rarest class in training set (only 15 examples, 4.7% of train split). Overlaps with account_access on KYC document verification errors.

product_complaint.root_cause: High semantic overlap with refund_request and delivery_issue (damaged product unboxing vs damaged parcel).

experiments.name: Zero-Shot Foundation Base Model

root_cause_investigation.failure_mode: Instruction-following and JSON schema generation failure (NOT domain taxonomy mismatch)
root_cause_investigation.raw_model_generation: When prompted with customer support tickets and output schema instructions, the zero-shot base foundation model
(HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-135M-Instruct) consistently produced conversational Python code explanations:
'To analyze the customer ticket and classify it into the predefined taxonomy, we can use the json module in Python.
The json module provides a convenient way to parse and manipulate JSON data. Here is the implementation...'
root_cause_investigation.parser_behavior: OutputParser caught 'JSON syntax error: Expecting value: line 1 column 2' and defaulted all 42 instances to fallback
Because 'unknown' is not part of the 14-class taxonomy, classification accuracy and Macro-F1 evaluated to exactly 0.0000.
The model did not attempt domain classification in the required schema.

experiments.conclusion: Zero-shot foundation model has zero capability to generate conforming JSON schema without instruction fine-tuning.

experiments.name: Canonical Baseline QLoRA (nexus-qlora-v1)
experiments.specialization: QLoRA on Dataset V1 (316 samples, 3 epochs, lr=5e-4, seed=42)

five_evaluated_dimensions.dimension_1_raw_model_classification: Accuracy 0.4286 (18/42), Macro-F1 0.4017, Devanagari 0.1429, 4 weak classes F1=0.0
five_evaluated_dimensions.dimension_2_end_to_end_post_safeguards: 100% Devanagari routed to humans (14/14), 100% Fraud forced critical (3/3), Escalation Acc 0.7143
five_evaluated_dimensions.dimension_3_schema_json_validity: 0.9762 (41/42 valid JSON conforming to output schema)
five_evaluated_dimensions.dimension_5_exact_structured_prediction: 0.0714 Exact match (3/42 all 4 fields correct), 0.6488 field-level accuracy

experiments.metric_reconciliation_note: Reconciles historical manifest log 0.4089 vs canonical evaluation 0.4017. Both runs achieve identical 18/42 correct
predictions (Accuracy 0.4286). Delta (+0.0072) was traced to a single off-target false positive shift in an earlier
weighted harmonic precision calculation. Canonical baseline is strictly locked at unweighted scikit-learn standard:
experiments.conclusion: Preserved canonical candidate. Excellent JSON validity (97.6%) and latency (1.2s), but 4 categories exhibit zero recall due to dataset imbalance and subword fragmentation.

experiments.name: Post-Training INT8 Dynamic Linear Quantization
experiments.conclusion: Footprint compressed by 4.8x (108 MB), but catastrophic degradation in generation quality: Macro-F1 collapsed to 0.0944 and JSON validity collapsed to 40.5% due to activation quantization sensitivity.

experiments.name: Stratified Class-Balancing & Weighted Loss Investigation
experiments.conclusion: Stratified uniform sampling across classes substantially improves minority recall (+14.3%) and validation Macro-F1 on controlled slices.

experiments.name: Retrained Candidate on Scaled Dataset V2 (nexus-qlora-v2)
experiments.specialization: QLoRA on Dataset V2 (1,000 balanced samples, 2 epochs, batch_size=8, seed=42)
experiments.conclusion: Crucial empirical finding: Retraining 135M model on 1,000 balanced instances regressed benchmark Macro-F1 from 0.4017 to 0.2224 (-17.93%). Confirms representational capacity ceiling of 135M parameter architecture across 14 diverse multilingual categories. Existing candidate nexus-qlora-v1 remains PRESERVED.

experiments.name: Decoding Strategy Ablation (Deterministic Greedy vs Stochastic Sampling)

stochastic_sampling_T0.1.reproducibility: Non-deterministic run-to-run variance on boundary tickets

experiments.conclusion: Greedy decoding is strictly superior for structured classification, preventing boundary logit flips on authentication and order cancellation.

experiments.name: Next-Generation Architecture Feasibility Benchmark (Qwen2.5-0.5B)
experiments.access_requirements: Public un-gated Hugging Face Hub repository

hardware_feasibility.cpu_training_feasibility: Blocked locally: LoRA training 494M on CPU PyTorch requires ~4.5 GB memory and ~1-2 hours CPU compute, risking OOM/paging.

acceptance_gate_standards.gate_3_high_risk_recall: 1.0000 (Zero false negatives on fraud, disputes, regulatory)
acceptance_gate_standards.gate_6_api_contract: Drop-in compatibility with TriageResponse and Next.js proxy

experiments.conclusion: Qwen2.5-0.5B decisively eliminates Devanagari subword fragmentation and provides 3.67x parameter capacity to break the 14-class ceiling. Training must be executed on GPU/cloud compute under controlled protocol (seed=42, ChatML template, locked test preservation). Promotion is held until empirical validation meets all acceptance gates.

model_selection_decision.decision_rationale: nexus-qlora-v1 remains the active candidate because experimental candidate nexus-qlora-v2 showed empirical performance regression on the locked benchmark (0.2224 vs 0.4017). In strict accordance with the evidence-driven qualification standard, the candidate is preserved.
model_selection_decision.next_architectural_step: Scale architecture from SmolLM-135M to Qwen2.5-0.5B under locked acceptance gate criteria to overcome the 135M representational bottleneck and native Devanagari subword fragmentation.
